QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_33

question.text: Upon completion of winding-up of a Cat III AIF, the Certificate of Registration shall be:

answer.text: Retained by the Manager for 10 years

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Chapter 13.5: 'Upon completion of the winding-up of the Fund by any of the processes mentioned above, the Certificate of Registration shall be SURRENDERED to SEBI.' This is a clean closure requirement. **The Trap:** Retention (A), auction (C), trustee-transfer (D) are invented distractors. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C/D test the same surrender rule. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Surrender the CoR only after final investor distribution and audited wind-up accounts are filed. The 5-year record-retention clock (Reg 27) continues post-surrender.
